synonyms: I Broke Dead End Flag and I Became a Hero
When the Villainous Noble Embraced His Role and Became a Hero
When the Villainous Noble Embraced His Role and Broke the Doom Flags with "Power," He Unexpectedly Became a Hero to the Heroines
synopsis: I found myself reincarnated as the villain in a game called “Kaleido Lily Academy.” The villain in question—Ix Vandille, the heir of the Count’s family—was a typical scumbag. Hated by many, he was condemned and killed in every scenario set in the academy. At this rate, I would die as soon as I entered the academy. However, my bad reputation knew no bounds, and it was too late to reform myself now. Therefore… “That’s it! If I become stronger than the protagonists and show them my power, they won’t dare to oppose me…!” To avoid being killed by the protagonists, I must become stronger than them. If I display my power, they won’t think of making a move against me. And if they do, I will just defeat them. With this resolve, Ix spent the three years before the academy began training desperately. “…Master, your strength is unmatched by anyone your age now.” “Hahaha! This is all due to my perseverance!” Ix became stronger than the protagonists. And soon, he began to show his strength to the protagonists, the heroine princess, noble daughters, and saintesses… but for some reason, he started being regarded as a hero.

title: Xing Jia Hun Jiang Zhuan
synopsis: Song Yunxiang, humanity's final mecha-sorceror, was reborn back to his schoolboy days with a powerful System. Last time when he was young, he was shunned for his lack of spiritual constitution. Because he was weak, he could only watch as his friends and comrades died in the oncoming war. In this life, he returns with a System along with 60 years of combat experience and technical knowledge. This time, back on campus, he will use his newfound power to create new mecha and destroy the monsters… All his regrets, all the friends that he missed, this time he will not make the same mistakes. (Source: Tencent, translated)

synonyms: Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything
synopsis: Betrayed by his best friend, our protagonist loses everything: billions in wealth, his loved ones, and even his legs. In “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything,” he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with a burning desire for vengeance, he vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him. When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By getting into the game early and spending heavily, he can acquire a god-level skill known as "Evolve Everything." Now he prepares to exact his revenge. With his unmatched knowledge and newfound powers, he embarks on a journey to dominate the game and take back his rightful place in the world.
